title: hieracium acrovillosum
intro: Hieracium acrovillosum, commonly known as Hawk's Beard, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The plant is used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium acrovillosum include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibiting immunomodulatory and anti-allergic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
